title: Bias-Aware BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution lowercases and regex-tokenizes comments, builds a train-only word vocabulary with padding and unknown tokens, and truncates sequences to 256 tokens. A randomly initialized embedding feeds spatial dropout and two stacked bidirectional LSTMs. Masked max and mean pooling from both LSTM layers are concatenated, passed through two ReLU dense layers with a residual addition, and used for a toxicity logit plus sigmoid-based identity auxiliary logits. Training upweights identity-containing examples, background positives, and subgroup negatives in per-example binary cross-entropy; auxiliary identity BCE is added with unit weight. Length-bucketed shuffled batches reduce padding. AdamW uses separate embedding and non-embedding groups, mixed precision, gradient scaling, norm clipping, 200-step warmup, and exponential per-epoch learning-rate decay. At inference, sequences are length-sorted and dynamically trimmed per batch. Predictions from every epoch are combined using normalized weights proportional to 2^epoch.
